status: Core extra owned race/no-repeat rule approved. Normal acquired-race event execution and saved Archetype continuation use existing acquisition contracts; combined body/Size profiles and runtime executor remain configuration.

confirmed: Mutant spins the Race wheel and gains its result as an additional race: race mutation.
The same-race exclusion still applies: every previously acquired canonical family, including nested identity families, is disabled.
authority.executionInterpretation: Reuse ordinary character-identity acquisition: retain existing races/rewards, run the new race's approved immediate/nested events, then return to the selected Mutant event and Backstory. Exactly one additional root draw, not a guarantee of exactly two total families when a wrapper/Hybrid opens descendants.

contracts.order: Actual Mutant result/reaction -> one canonical mutation-family draw from unused families -> commit owned root and global history before dispatch/reaction -> complete selected immediate/nested Race events -> restore Mutant continuation -> Backstory.
contracts.addition: The earlier Race components and their original journals/grants remain owned. Link one new root to the actual Mutant source; do not replace the base race or activate the main Hybrid event just because two races are now owned.
contracts.noRepeat: Use canonical family IDs, not display aliases or subtype IDs. Elf already used excludes the entire Elf family, not just the earlier Elf subtype. All preceding outer/nested families and newly committed mutation descendants share one usedRaceFamilyIds set. Vampire prey, Slayer victims, mentors and companions remain separate references.
contracts.raceEvents: Run normal approved new-race mechanics with actual source provenance. If the result is Hybrid, run its two roots in order; Symbiote host, Raksasa base and Skeleton/Zombie origin use their ordinary bounded routes. Finish each child chain before returning. Selecting these families schedules no second Mutant/root invocation.
contracts.reward: Mutant has no independent stat/power/weapon/mastery package. Gains come only from the actually acquired race and its approved events, source-once. Existing modifiers/inventory remain; source-scoped God maximum stays on its own Authority instance.
contracts.stageBoundary: Archetype eligibility/result was already committed against the completed pre-mutation Race tree. Reuse that frozen decision; do not re-enter the gate, redraw Archetype, undo Mutant or retroactively skip it when mutation acquires a strong/always-skip race. Raksasa acquired during mutation still binds giant Size, but cannot erase a previously selected Archetype. New identity children return to the saved event, not the top-level Race->Archetype transition.
contracts.deferredStages: Keep the original global Backstory->Size->five stats->Weapon/Power/mastery sequence. Mutation race events register approved later-stage effects/tickets without advancing stages. One global Size uses the completed current composition, including giant binding when applicable; no early/extra Size draw. Retain normal None ownership, per-weapon mastery/compatible Enchant and one common Power Mastery.
contracts.identityAndBody: Keep a frozen pre-Archetype eligibility tree/decision separately from current acquired-race composition. Mutation roots and their descendants are owned identity records, not extra children patched into an ordinary Human/Elf gate-input node. Body/fusion/Size and equipment-fit profiles must explicitly cover the current components; missing profiles require configuration, never Human fallback or inferred immunity/form/bonus.
contracts.ledger: Freeze rule version, canonical race catalog/weights, exclusion snapshot, selected family, owned root ID, source links and exact saved continuations. Atomically commit selection/history before child dispatch. Each inherited race effect uses its own source ledger; replay/media retry schedules no new root, repeat child event, grant or modifier.
contracts.bounded: Each actual identity-family commit increases the one used set; the nineteen-family catalog bounds all original and mutation chains together. Exhaustion blocks the required child explicitly; never reopen a used family or erase a committed result.
contracts.reaction: At Mutant reveal, only extra-race intent is known. After mutation result append the actual added race, then actual subtypes/grants as each result commits. Future Backstory/Size/stats/mastery remain unknown; no caption-derived funny-result tag.
contracts.return: After every mandatory immediate mutation child returns and reacts, complete Mutant once and restore Backstory. Keep deferred tickets for their normal stages.

invocationTemplate.label: Mutasi Ras
invocationTemplate.guard: Selected Mutant event source is active; familyId not in character.usedRaceFamilyIds, intersect separately approved caller eligibility.
invocationTemplate.odds: Reuse current canonical Race strength weights under shared history/guards and approved modifiers; normalize/freeze survivors. Full band ratios may shift after exclusions; active Equalizer replaces final weights after guards.
invocationTemplate.dispatchPolicy: Execute the selected family's approved immediate events once under a new owned mutation root/source. Nested Hybrid/host/base/origin identity draws share the same character history and exclusions.
invocationTemplate.registration: Reference invocation of the existing canonical pool, not a duplicate race catalog or a nineteenth family.
invocationTemplate.returnTo: saved Mutant event continuation, then Backstory
invocationTemplate.emptyPool: needs_configuration; no actual draw or invented None, repeated race, reset of history, or silent success. Keep required invocation pending.
